sentences.text:
In Re: Saikat Sarkar & Ors.
 ...Peti
 Mr. Jayanta Narayan Chatterjee, Sr. Adv,
 Mr. Sirsendu Sinha Roy,
 Mrs. Paramita Mukhopadhyay,
 Mr. Supreem Naskar,
 Ms. Jayashree Patra,
 Ms. Debarati Mukherjee.
 .... For the Peti
 1.
The instant revisional application has been filed for quashing the entire proceeding.

The present petitioners being the husband, mother-in-law and brother-in-law of the opposite party No.2 against whom the complaint has been lodged under Sections 498A/406/34 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860.

2. The marriage is of 2013 and one minor daughter and several rounds of litigations are pending between the parties including this proceeding initiated in the year 2019 under Domestic Violence Act and also previous complaint lodged by the present petitioner No.1 against the opposite party No.2 under Section 341/323/506/34 of the Indian Penal Code and also suit for restitution for conjugal rights by the present petitioner No.1.
3.
Despite the above factual matrix, the complaint has been lodged in the year 2023 under Section 156(3) of Cr.P.C alleging the incident of September, 2019, suppressing all other proceedings therein.
4. Therefore, prima facie arguable case has been made out by the petitioners for which the matter is required to be heard.

5. The petitioners are directed to serve a copy of the application to the opposite party through speed post as well as the office of the public prosecutor and file affidavit of service on the next date of hearing.

6. The matter to appear two weeks hence under the heading 'contested application' and in the meantime all further proceedings be stayed till 30th April, 2026 or until further order whichever is earlier002E (Chaitali Chatterjee (Das), J.)
CRR/1355/2025 on 26 February, 2026 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/26648897/
